summary: Excellent, comprehensive test suite spanning all requirements: version parsing/arithmetic, commit parsing (all conventional commit variants), bump decision logic, changelog generation, file I/O (plain text and JSON), CLI with all options, and workflow structure validation. TDD approach is clearly followed with logical organization into cycles. Integration testing via act is particularly strong, testing real GitHub Actions execution. Fixtures are well-designed and independent tests are properly isolated. Minor gaps: unicode in commits, very long inputs, and git-not-available error path are not explicitly tested. Would reliably catch regressions in core logic and workflow behavior.
